repo: Project uses a structured planning system under .planning/phases/ with numbered phase directories
Planning phases follow a naming convention: {phase-number}-{phase-name} (e.g., 40-desktop-vault-settings-integration)
Phase artifacts are prefixed with the phase number (e.g., 40-RESEARCH.md, 40-VALIDATION.md)
Templates for planning documents are stored in .claude/get-shit-done/templates/
workflow: A Researcher agent is used to produce RESEARCH.md artifacts before validation planning begins
VALIDATION.md is generated from a template after confirming the Validation Architecture section exists in RESEARCH.md
Research and validation docs are committed together as a unit
